findings.description: The remediated database contract binds the per-change head to the full phase and transition_sequence generation, accepts only exact-generation submit retries, and rejects equal-sequence/different-phase submissions before they can create a second active generation.
findings.resolution: Preserve the forced reconcile-first/equal-sequence-different-phase PostgreSQL test during implementation.

findings.description: Both projection mutation endpoints now publish explicit RFC 7807 409 responses, aligning the OpenAPI contract with stale, future, and generation-mismatch conflict behavior in the design and tasks.
findings.resolution: Preserve machine-readable 409 reason assertions in the HTTP tests.

findings.description: Nit: The final integration plan correctly runs test_mcp_work_projection.py in the coordinator-venv transport suite, but redundantly lists the same coordinator test in the subsequent skills-venv command, imposing an unnecessary cross-environment dependency.
findings.resolution: Remove the duplicate from the skills-venv command during implementation housekeeping while retaining the correct coordinator-venv gate; this does not block implementation.

findings.description: The plan pins reconciliation authorization to the existing submit_work policy action with mode=reconcile and requires denial parity across HTTP, direct MCP, proxy MCP, and CLI.
findings.resolution: Preserve the authorization-context and denial-envelope tests.

findings.description: Persist-first callback ordering, no rollback on projection failure, and resume reconciliation derived only from loaded loop-state preserve one-way authoritative truth across the filesystem/database crash window.
findings.resolution: Preserve the save-before-project, failed-save short-circuit, response non-authority, and resume-before-phase tests.
